content.title: Order-level partial refunds
content.businessOutcome: Reduce support-assisted refunds while preserving captured-balance and ledger correctness.
content.successMetric: Illustrative: support-assisted partial refunds per week; baseline and target require business validation.
content.currentBehavior: Historical full-refund-only policy conflicts with a newer amount request field. Atomic cumulative reservation is absent in the code fixture.
businessRules: Positive integer minor units in captured currency
Sum of committed and reserved refunds may not exceed captured amount
Duplicate idempotency key must not create duplicate refund

acceptance.given: 10000 minor units captured and 3000 already refunded
acceptance.then: Eligible refund accepted; remaining committed balance becomes 5000

acceptance.given: Concurrent requests exceed remaining balance in aggregate

acceptance.then: Original result returned without duplicate reversal
